sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a ship underway noticed two robbers armed with knives and notified the Master. General alarm raised and PA announcement made resulting in the robbers escaping with stolen ship’s stores. Incident reported to VTIS.
